verdict.rationale: Board approvals are built into every relevant platform workflow, and option award agreements are tied to the corresponding board consent. Grants are priced against FMV by default, with an explicit setting needed to allow above- or below-FMV pricing. 409A valuations are offered through third-party provider partners on the Growth plan, and Gusto offer-letter promises can be granted automatically. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the 409A value auto-populates the strike price inside the grant workflow, a single documented step-by-step new-hire grant walkthrough, independent or hands-on corroboration, and in-house 409A (it is partner-delivered and tier-gated).
